CREATE TABLE pc_atomic_memory_alias (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	alias_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	target_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	alias_revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	merged_state_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	projection_format VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	searchable_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	embedding BLOB, 
	profile_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	embedding_input_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, alias_artifact_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_alias_revision CHECK (alias_revision > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_alias_state_version CHECK (merged_state_version >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_alias_embedding_metadata CHECK ((embedding IS NULL AND profile_fingerprint IS NULL AND embedding_input_hash IS NULL) OR (embedding IS NOT NULL AND profile_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND embedding_input_hash IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_memory_work_blocks (
	block_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_after BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_through BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	active INTEGER, 
	input_fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	estimated_input_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	effective_budget BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	token_estimator_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	failure_location VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	blocked_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	retried_at DATETIME, 
	retry_request_generation BIGINT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (block_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_memory_block_window CHECK (source_after >= 0 AND source_through = source_after + 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_memory_block_budget CHECK (effective_budget > 0 AND estimated_input_tokens > effective_budget), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_memory_block_acceptance CHECK ((active IS NOT NULL AND active = 1 AND retried_at IS NULL AND retry_request_generation IS NULL) OR (active IS NULL AND retried_at IS NOT NULL AND retry_request_generation IS NOT NULL AND retry_request_generation > 0)), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_memory_block_frontier UNIQUE (scope_id, binding_name, source_after, active)
)
